style.styleTitle: Homcom 7ft Artificial Christmas Tree With Metal Base And Hinged Branches
style.toneOfVoice: <p>An essential centrepiece for the Christmas season, which can be used this year and next - go for this HOMCOM artificial Christmas tree. Made from plastic, this is a stable piece which can used many times over; with 1821 tips it is lush and voluptuous - looks so realistic! The bare design means you can dress it up with any decorations and lights as you like - so how you want your Christmas home to look like, is entirely up to you. Xmas tree is complete with a metal base to weigh down.</p><ul><li>Fully artificial design, it is flame retardant for safety. Keep away from direct flames!;</li><li>6ft tall, with 1821 branches: a tall and voluptuous design, looks like a real tree;</li><li>Bare design to dress with your favourite decorations and lights;</li><li>Hinges and easy-to-shape moulded branches for quick and easy setup;</li><li>Metal base keeps the xmas tree weighted to stand steady in place;</li><li>Colour: Green;</li><li>Material: Plastic, Metal;</li><li>Overall Dimension: F117 x 180Hcm;</li><li>Tree Height: 6ft;</li><li>Tip Count: 1821;</li><li>Item Label: 830-886V02GN;</li></ul><p>Note:;</p><p>Only for indoor use, not for outdoor;</p><p>In order to get a full appearance, please spread out all individual tips to get the best possible look from the tree, suggest you to take 15 minutes to shape the tree.</p>
